metadata.description: The Experience Validation Engine (EVE) — AI that experiences software like a human.

plugins.name: eve
plugins.description: Validate software the way a human experiences it: simulate a persona using your app and get an evidence-backed experience report (scores, findings, first-person journal). Adds the EVE MCP tools (eve_run_session, eve_list_personas, eve_benchmark, …) plus the /eve skill.
